ScoreChip
ScoreChip · Components/LightBadge.swift
The number on its band fill: one amber hue ordered by lightness, with a hairline so pale bands show against the window.
Deviation 7: literal opacity 0.85
Low confidence opacity 0.85 is hard-coded in ScoreChip (LightBadge.swift:124).

Sizes
compact 18 high, regular 22 high, large 64 square (radius card). Text uses type/score/badge, medium and large with tabular numerals. Band colours are the Light Index ramp: never green, red or coral.
